newsitem.title: USA: Foreign share of Japan chip market 32.6 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Foreign share of Japan chip market 32.6 pct in Q1.

text.p: The foreign share of the Japanese semiconductor market was a record 32.6 percent in the first quarter, the Office of the United States Trade Representative said Monday.
That was up from 29.4 percent in the last quarter of 1996 and eclipsed the previous record of 29.6 percent in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Increased sales by U.S. companies contributed to the improved foreign share, USTR said in a statement.
"I am pleased by foreign suppliers' continued progress in penetrating the Japanese semiconductor market," said U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky.
"This is evidence that market forces are at work. We will continue to monitor the situation closely to ensure that the foreign share of the Japanese market remains strong."
